_comment: GlyphStudio SOVEREIGN policy file (STUB). Generated from curated-allowlist.jsonc. This is the POLICY-FILE form consumed by FilePolicyService (src/vs/platform/policy/common/filePolicyService.ts). Place at /etc/vscode/policy.json (Linux), or ~/.glyphstudio/policy.json when launched with --__enable-file-policy, or deliver the equivalent values via OS managed prefs (macOS dev.glyphstudio.app) / registry (Windows GlyphStudio). NOTE: the top-level key is the POLICY NAME 'AllowedExtensions' (extensionManagement.ts:744), NOT the setting id 'extensions.allowed'.
